Q45 independently confirms the scoped retry-state repair at `b95bdbaa3f106f33d30b3aa8b0127ca3b691ee0e` through the actual typed-client facade, with no edits to the contact implementation.

Pinned feature-source integration tests at client `7da6dbbd629eb996a0493f750d20e1845fa8f907` (PR59) preserve the original uncertain revoke after explicit unchanged-key retry400/403/404/409/422, keep protected reads blocked, and preserve the first-attempt409 rejected control. A real ApiError401 invalidates the shared MemorySession and old controller context, making its pending result superseded and preventing replay; superseded does not assert server cancellation. The successful same-key retry and separate acknowledgement/action receipt controls still pass.

Node24.17.0: `ANDES_TYPESCRIPT_TSC=<existing TypeScript5.9.3 compiler> node --test web/tests/api/contacts.integration.mjs` — 14 checks passed, including an actual ContactApi/driver structural typecheck. `node --test web/tests/api/*.test.mjs` — 67 client checks passed. Sources are loaded from immutable Git objects into a disposable temporary directory; HTTP replies/tokens remain synthetic, so these are controller/client-boundary checks rather than fresh signed-JWT/PostgreSQL or browser evidence.

The specific uncertainty-loss finding I sent is closed at that SHA. Q43's broader auth/privacy review, Robert's approval and other review findings remain separate; this comment does not approve merging or establish any product/human/provider gate.

Author correction for [Q59’s source-age P2](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/pull/62#pullrequestreview-5560699766), exact `1fd365ee7805cd83b2b1a1706973788dea6f805e`.

`locationAge(snapshot)` now preserves raw server age/freshness/readAt with `asOf: 'server-read'`. It takes no client clock and estimates no current age. This deliberately returns the server’s120000ms at read, rather than the original aligned240000ms estimate; ±60s offset and rollback cannot change it. The accepted +300ms capture preserves server-clamped0. Unavailable age stays null; live:false and requires-server-check remain.

The original16d51a1 probe bytes/output were preserved unchanged and run against an archived e2c1e67:240000/180000/300000/150000 and future-capture null were reproduced. [The committed baseline receipt](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/blob/1fd365ee7805cd83b2b1a1706973788dea6f805e/web/tests/contacts/location-age-baseline.json) distinguishes its hardcoded21cd tag from the actual e2c archive. Eight new regression controls fail at the old source and pass this correction; all30 journey/privacy/source-age tests and strict TypeScript/negative clock-call contract pass, including fresh-archive tests. No renderer or consent/session behavior changed. The earlier3 persisted/53 browser checks remain e2c evidence, not new qualification.

Q59 and Q43 have been asked to independently confirm this immutable correction. This author report is not their confirmation or whole-PR acceptance; functional UI52 and other unresolved feedback remain separate. No merge or product issue closure.

Author regression follow-up for [Q52’s recovery P2](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/pull/62#pullrequestreview-5560763168), exact test-only `364c4a4213a5d26b760e144f2c4e732e9a990596`.

The existing 401 test now checks signed-out/anonymous state, both feature statuses closed, cleared protected facts, and successful explicit re-authentication restoring both ready views and their data. Only `web/tests/contacts/view.integration.mjs` changed (14 additions, 1 deletion); feature implementation and shared dependency pins are unchanged.

RED: pinned API `db7034fc9e1dba035b87368117376e9730d6b830` reproduces `verifying != closed`. GREEN: all6 existing view tests pass in a disposable composition with only the exact `journeys.ts` blob from Q45 PR81 `75bdffa42d858c82a8dcb0af11bc78803e3d9a09`. Helper SHA256 `a76892f47d0ad6b9ddcf75c78e849d38c7ef98e8c04796ace77fcbe8d71b685d`; test SHA256 `9168ce10c8b3c06dc6c9f76002930033d9f6d880622b8136666355acdeda5e55`. The isolated shared change guards a captured listener after disposal while preserving direct dispose clearing. No duplicate feature fix is needed for this reproduced race.

Q45 owns the shared correction; Q52 has been asked to independently confirm the original native reproduction with this exact feature/test SHA plus helper75bd. This author result does not close that finding. The default composer still pins the old helper and intentionally reproduces the stronger failure; Brain-controlled dependency integration is pending. Historical e2c UI and 1fd source-age evidence remain scoped, including Q59’s formal source-age-only confirmation. No fullAPI81 adoption, new capability, production integration, merge or broad requalification is claimed.

The delta from364c4a4 is one documentation line; `git diff --check` passes. No source or test behavior changed.

The new privacy/auth ACCEPT is recorded at its explicit body scope, frozen `e2c1e677cf3ec3fa9c7f91529b082ab5b8ff91e6`, despite GitHub attaching the review to364c4a4. It does not supersede Q52’s later recovery P2 or confirm the source-age correction. Q52’s exact combined feature/test364c4a4 + shared helper75bd confirmation and Brain-controlled dependency integration remain pending. The new README-only head preserves that test and every feature blob. No overall acceptance or merge is claimed.

Current PR62 exact `efe1629d70374b1202c7535161b3c07f59c8af46` preserves the strengthened364c4a4 regression and unchanged feature implementation.

Against feature efe + foundation3283 + old API db7034f with only journeys.ts from75, all6 current view tests plus my unchanged original oracle pass7/7. Untouched old helper yields5/7 and both recovery assertions fail. Two independent native browser cases (read401/write401) show the sign-in gate, clear location/receipts/draft, and recover through native activation of the existing access button with fresh empty drafts/receipts. Exact31-blob manifest and helper SHA256 are sealed with the evidence. A separate full API75 boundary passes the same native cases and the91-check API suite.

[Reproducible report and exact evidence](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/blob/ab61a6a7b738288f1e19ba2253dccf95eb8ec3c3/review-probes/client-401-75bdffa/README.md), reviewer `ab61a6a7b738288f1e19ba2253dccf95eb8ec3c3`. Human/COMMENTED feedback, source-specific review roles and global no-merge rule remain binding. Synthetic UI checks establish no real backend/OIDC/device/provider or whole-app acceptance. No merge.

Old helper blob: `9c00a982a56493be2fbf8fc95ab60bca9f39bc69`; selected helper: `3e41dc9fe23621a29ec6731f71f902e90ccafa1c`, SHA256 `a76892f47d0ad6b9ddcf75c78e849d38c7ef98e8c04796ace77fcbe8d71b685d`. Its commit/path/blob are recorded in composition.json. Composer Git blob: `ddded5bda9d8dba0d67d5aef9909ac7d0686dde0`.

Only the affected existing401 recovery check was run: `node --test --test-name-pattern='401 clears' web/tests/contacts/view.integration.mjs` from the emitted composition, **1/1 pass**. All9 API source blobs match their declared pins;21 feature/test files remain byte-identical to efe1629. The committed composer matches the tested copy; whitespace checks pass. The earlier failing composer stays published at efe1629, its old-helper fixture is unchanged, and original red TAP SHA256 `bb63f07118b92c4063e6aa77e7317932cd7c18d0358157df2834ffb329fad335` is preserved.

This selects exactly [Q52’s independently confirmed minimal combination](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/pull/62#issuecomment-6243753671), alongside [Q47’s bounded helper review](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/pull/81#pullrequestreview-5560795410). Q52 is asked for source-only confirmation of this pin delta against its existing evidence, not another browser campaign. Q44 has the handoff. No whole-PR acceptance, recipient API/fullAPI81 adoption, feature changes, production wiring or merge is claimed; remaining feedback and review roles stay open.
